subject: Onward transfer authorization request: EdgeCache Ltd (logging subprocessor)
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@dataflowai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: privacy@dataflowai.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onward transfer notice — EdgeCache Ltd (EU logging edge)
Attachments: DataFlow_Change_Notice_EdgeCache.pdf, EdgeCache_SOC2_TypeII.pdf

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — following our contract clause on subprocessor notification, we’re writing to notify Redwood of a planned onboarding of a downstream vendor: EdgeCache Ltd (UK/EU-based). EdgeCache will provide ephemeral log caching and edge aggregation for DataFlow’s EU region to reduce latency for EU customers.

Key points:
- Purpose: transient caching and aggregated request logs for troubleshooting
- Data types: pseudonymized request IDs, timestamp, routing metadata, minimal IP prefixes (no full PII)
- Retention: 30 days by default, configurable to 0/7/30 days per controller requests
- Location: originating EU regions; no routing to US except for aggregated metrics
- Security: EdgeCache operates under a subprocessor contract with AES-256 at-rest, TLS1.3 in transit; SOC2 Type II report attached.

We’ve attached our change notice and EdgeCache’s SOC2 report. Please confirm whether Redwood raises any objections or requires additional evidence (DPIA, SCCs, KMS details) within 10 business days so we can schedule the onboarding (target deploy window: early Dec).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Integrations
DataFlow Analytics
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@dataflowai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onward transfer notice — EdgeCache Ltd (EU logging edge)

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. I’ve looped in our Security & GTM leads to review.

Before we can sign off (or confirm any objections), we need the following items from DataFlow / EdgeCache:
1) DPIA summary specific to the EdgeCache integration (high-level risks, mitigations, residual risk rating)
2) Clear dataflow diagram showing where pseudonymized identifiers and IP prefixes transit and where any aggregated metrics leave the EU (if at all)
3) Evidence of SCCs or EU adequacy clauses if data may be transferred outside EU (signed DPA addendum is fine)
4) EdgeCache key management details (does EdgeCache control keys, or are keys customer/DF-managed; HSM/KMS vendor and location)
5) Clarification on whether EdgeCache will ever receive full request payloads or any fields classed as PII under our DPA
6) Updated vendor roster entry and a contact for security operations at EdgeCache for future incident coordination

Please provide those items within 7 business days. If you can supply a brief summary PDF and the full DPA addendum draft (EdgeCache_DPA_Addendum.docx), that will speed review.

If we can get the DPIA + dataflow, we may be able to provide a conditional, region-scoped approval (EU-only) to support a canary rollout while legal completes the DPA amendment review.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Onward transfer notice — EdgeCache Ltd (EU logging edge)

Evelyn / Karthik — quick internal note on the requested items and our preferred path:

- If EdgeCache confirms they only receive pseudonymized IDs + IP prefix (no stable identifiers) and retention is strictly 30 days with controls, we can allow a limited EU canary (10% EU traffic) while DPA addendum is finalized.
- Legal should review EdgeCache_DPA_Addendum.docx for SCC/transfer language — suggest we push for explicit SCC module chaining and an explicit onward transfer prohibition to third countries without our approval.
- Security wants the DPIA summary and dataflow diagram; if missing, we should withhold approval.
- Ops: request that EdgeCache provide an audit-log feed (read-only) for 90 days in case of incident triage.

Decision points for exec: Lauren, do you want to approve conditional EU-only canary pending the above, or hold until full DPA? I recommend conditional to avoid blocking DataFlow’s release cadence, provided we get the DPIA and DPA addendum within 7 business days and SOC2 evidence (they already attached).

—Neha
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@dataflowai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onward transfer notice — EdgeCache Ltd (EU logging edge)

Sara — appreciate the quick follow-up earlier today. After internal review we can offer a conditional EU-only approval to proceed with a canary deployment under the following conditions: 

1) Deliverables (required before canary):
   - DPIA summary (2-3 pages) documenting threat model and mitigations
   - Updated dataflow diagram (proposed-dataflow-eu.png) showing no egress of detailed payloads to non-EU regions
   - Signed DPA addendum with explicit SCC chaining or equivalent transfer protections (EdgeCache_DPA_Addendum.docx)
   - Clarify KMS/HSM custody model (EdgeCache must confirm keys are EU-only or provide cross-border KMS controls)
   - Point of contact for security ops at EdgeCache and SOC report (we received SOC2 — thanks)

2) Operational constraints during canary:
   - EU-only traffic segmentation (max 10% EU traffic) for 21 days
   - Retention capped at 30 days; log purge verification requested weekly during canary
   - Audit-log access: EdgeCache must provide read-only audit logs and an incident contact reachable 24/7 in case of suspected data exposure

3) Legal / procurement requirements:
   - We will execute the DPA addendum before full ramp; procurement to confirm SOW amendment and invoice terms

If DataFlow / EdgeCache can confirm and deliver the items above by COB next Tue (2026-11-30), we will authorize the limited canary. Otherwise Redwood will object to the onboarding until outstanding items are provided.

Please confirm and attach the DPIA summary and DPA addendum draft for legal review. Happy to schedule a 30-minute working session with Neha & Karthik if needed.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
